name: Auth0
subtitle: Enterprise identity platform (OAuth, OIDC, SAML)
creator: Eugenio Pace and Matias Woloski
description: A hosted identity platform built on open standards. It provides a hosted login page, social and enterprise connections, MFA, passwordless login, Actions that run code during sign-in, role-based access control and machine-to-machine tokens.
useCases: B2B and B2C apps across many languages

languages.written: SDKs for JS/TS, Java, .NET, Python, Go, PHP, iOS and Android
languages.youWrite: Your app's language; Actions are JavaScript

concepts.explanation: Your Auth0 account and each app registered in it.
Who the user is versus what they may call.
Social, database or enterprise identity sources.
Serverless hooks in the login pipeline.
B2B tenants with their own members.

codeSamples.label: JavaScript · SPA SDK

cons: Paid tiers get expensive quickly, especially B2B
Redirect UX feels less native than embedded components

pricing.summary: Free: up to 25,000 monthly active users. Essentials from $35/mo (B2C) or $150/mo (B2B). Professional from $240/mo (B2C) or $800/mo (B2B). Enterprise: custom.
